question: Where is the nearest restaurant along the route from Hamtramck Disneyland, Hamtramck, MI to University of Michigan Museum of Natural History, Ann Arbor, MI?
sql: WITH start_poi AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Hamtramck Disneyland%' LIMIT 1 ), end_poi AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%University of Michigan Museum of Natural History%' LIMIT 1 ), route_segment AS ( SELECT ST_MakeLine(s.geometry, e.geometry) AS geom FROM start_poi s, end_poi e ) SELECT poi_name, addr_city, addr_state FROM pois WHERE (amenity = 'restaurant' OR cuisine IS NOT NULL) AND ST_Intersects( pois.geometry::geography, ST_Buffer((SELECT geom FROM route_segment)::geography, 500)::geography -- 500 meter buffer along the route ) ORDER BY ST_Distance(pois.geometry::geography, (SELECT geom FROM route_segment)::geography) ASC LIMIT 1;
